sentiment.label: In form
sentiment.headline: French Open final: Alexander Zverev beats Flavio Cobolli in 5 sets for long-awaited first Grand Slam title - Yahoo Sports

picks.recommendation: Cobolli's substantial positive edge is driven by his superior ranking (#10) and positive/in form sentiment, indicating the market underestimates his chances against the lower-ranked Blockx on hard court. The lack of H2H history means his form is the primary differentiator.
